reviews.x: I have several splash bottles of men's cologne, and I needed a decent spray bottle to pour them into.  This bottle is well-made, with heavy glass, and has a powerful sprayer.  (Go easy on the trigger, because this sprayer puts out a huge fine mist -- you could wash windows with it!)  Bottles like this are hard to find in stores nowadays, so I was happy to find this here on Amazon.

This is an excellent atomizer and works great with a fine mist spray.  The seal is air tight and does not leak in your luggage or travel bag. It also came with a pipette and funnel, which were not mentioned in the listing.  They also work very well. Excellent quality!
This is just what I needed and the seal of the bottle is great!!!! Ship was fast as well. Will use it for my special buy refills.
i spent a lot of money on the perfume i put in this bottle. unfortunately, it all leaked when i brought it to travel.

Creates a great misty spray, but the pump inexplicably stopped working after about two months of light use. Don't really know how that happened ... it just sits on my dresser. Also, I noticed some leakage, even with the top screwed on tight. My bottle would be coated in a thin layer of cologne after usage. That wasn't really a big deal, but now that it has ceased to work completely, I'll have to find a replacement.

reviews.t: Excellent quality, size and sleek fancy look for an ...
reviews.x: Excellent quality, size and sleek fancy look for an affordable price. I would highly recommend it. It's also a good travel size and would fit easily in your purse. Practically, it's the size if a perfume rollerball but it's spray rather the applying it to the touch. It also comes within a cute duffle bag and a tiny funnel to help pour in your liquid/solution or parfum.

Perfect size for my toiletry travel bag!  Looks elegant and so convenient! It took me a while try to fill it up since my perfume bottle doesn't allow me to remove the pump to pour out the perfume.  I only filled it halfway because I got tired of literally spraying the perfume into the new bottle.

reviews.t: I love these! They allow me to mix my own ...
reviews.x: I love these!  They allow me to mix my own fragrance using essential oils and vodka.  My fave smells pretty close to Amazing Grace.  Love it!!!  The bottles always spray beautifully and don't clog.  Really pretty too.  Nice and heavy / thick glass.  No falling over.
I purchased this because one of my more expensive spay bottles broke and would not spay right. Best of all, it is reusable!

I had some baby perfume in a bottle for my daughter (who is no longer a baby) and she loves the scent.  It makes her feel grown up to wear perfume :-)  The problem was that the perfume was not in a spray bottle, just a regular bottle, and if she would try to put it on by herself she would need to take a shower b/c she just reeked of perfume. I got this bottle to see if having her spray a little perfume would give her the independence to do it for herself, but not overdo it.  It works beautifully

reviews.t: A perfect replacement for a broken perfume bottle.
reviews.x: This works perfectly as a new vessel for my favorite scent. It was simple to transfer my perfume from a leaking bottle to this replacement. I've had no problems with it spraying "too much", as other reviewers have claimed. I suppose it depends on the atomizer you wind up with. If I ever need another replacement-this would be the one.
This bottle is exactly what I was looking for.  I like to mix essential oils and various perfumes and the sprayer and size are great.  The included funnel makes it really easy to fill as well.

Don't you just love it when a product exceeds your expectations?  Not only is this bottle well designed and made, but I really appreciated the included squeeze bulb pipette for transferring. Like a previous reviewer, I had a broken spritzer on a nonrefillable bottle of juice and attempts to fill smaller bottles using a funnel resulted in spills.  The bottle has substance - a good weight and thickness. The spritzer screws securely onto the bottle with no leaking and provides a even wide spray. I

I checked countless refillable atomizers before deciding on this one because: - Perfume is to be poured in rather than pumped in as i have an "eau de parfum" bottle that has a screw on cap rather than an atomizer. The ability to pour eliminated a lot of offers such as the Travalo products. In fact it is often unclear if a refillable atomizer accepts pour in. - The review were convincing.  The glass is sturdy and simple, the inside hose goes all the way to the end. The spray is misty. The

I got this to use for a bottle of cologne that came with just a stopper, because my boyfriend uses it less frequently than his fragrances with atomizer bottles. The bottle itself is nice and sturdy, and looks just like the picture. We didn't use a funnel or anything, because the openings on both the old bottle and this one were wide enough to allow easy pouring between them. And the mist was fine enough to replicate his other fragrances that came with atomizers, and now he uses that scent way mo

I bought this to refill my Travalo atomizer, since my perfume's new package design is incompatible with it. The nozzle on this little bottle barely fits the Travalo, leaving puddles of perfume nearly everywhere *but* the atomizer. I realize this is a very specific use case, though -- I have no use for this little bottle now, but it seems like a good product for people who are looking for a smaller bottle to use for traveling.

The bottle is nice enough, but the tube inside only reaches halfway down into the bottle (someone else posted a photo - mine is about the same). I bought this exact product in 2016 and the tube was nice and long, reached the entire length and more. Must be either quality control issues or a general downgrade in quality. Would not recommend unless you plan on refilling every time it reaches the halfway point.

I like the look and the fact that this is glass. I bought it to use for an airplane approved travel size for my organic rose facial spray. In trying to keep things healthy, I wanted to avoid a plastic sprayer. The bottle itself is quality but the spray mist that comes out is a little harsh and I wish it sprayed softer. It also shoots out too much at a time.

My cologne bottle broke, and it was an expensive bottle and practically full to boot. Bought this to use in its place and it works great. It does put out a very fine mist. One thing I have noticed is that sometime gets stuck sort of speak and have to push down hard, but once it clears, it works fine. I alson love the shape of the bottle.

This bottle is exactly what I was looking for.  The spray is very fine (although it does spray a lot, you've been warned).  I needed a new bottle because the pump broke on a very expensive bottle of perfume.  This did the trick.  It has a very tight seal too- I have had it for a couple of months and there hasn't been any evaporation.

I convinced my brother to try the "fancy new" cologne I just purchased.  Because of the professional appearance of this bottle, it helped sell the prank.  I won't say what was in the new cologne I'll just hint that it was pee.  He's still mad but he agrees it's a FINE bottle!!

The glass bottle is very nice, easy to fill but I haven't even used 1/4 of the amount in the bottle and the spray top plunger broke. It pushed in, won't work and leaks cologne all over the place. Its a shame since the quality of the glass is very nice

It sprayed like a perfume bottle for like a minute before it just turned into a stream line spray. It does not bother me but it might bother other people who buys this for their perfume and not diy projects like myself.

It sprayed like a perfume bottle for like a minute before it just turned into a stream line spray. It does not bother me but it might bother other people who buys this for their perfume and not diy projects like myself.

Got this for my wife. I bought her some perfume but as a clueless man buying perfume I got a refill bottle.  She was skeptical when I said I purchased this.  But tried it out and said it works perfectly.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the bottle's quality, describing it as well-made with heavy, thick glass and a sturdy, elegant look.
Reviewers frequently highlight the fine, powerful mist the sprayer produces.
Several reviewers report leaking, including during travel, and one notes the pump stopped working after about two months.
Reviewers appreciate the included accessories like the pipette and funnel, which make transferring perfume easy.
Many reviewers find the size convenient for travel and toiletry bags, and like using it to refill or mix their own fragrances.
